faq.q: How do I change my DP on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Open WhatsApp, go to Settings, tap your name at the top, then tap the profile photo and choose Gallery. Pick the DP you downloaded, adjust the circular crop if you want, and confirm. It updates for everyone who has you saved.

faq.q: What is the correct WhatsApp DP size?
faq.a: Upload a square image of at least 500×500 pixels. WhatsApp displays it at roughly 192px and crops it to a circle, so extra resolution mainly protects it from looking soft after compression. The DPs here are square and 900×900 or larger.

faq.q: Why does my DP look blurry on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Usually because the original was small, or was already a screenshot of a compressed image, and WhatsApp compresses again on upload. Starting from a clean, square, reasonably large file — like the full-size downloads here — avoids most of it.
